name: openhuman-atlas
description: Explore human anatomy in an interactive 3D viewer and inspect the current scene.

interface.longDescription:
Explore human anatomy with an interactive 3D viewer inside your conversation. Show, hide, isolate, select and focus available anatomical structures; change view direction; undo and redo scene changes; and ask what you selected. Request visual inspection of the current canvas or a link opening the confirmed scene in the full OpenHuman Atlas.

Built by MedHue Labs LLC for anatomy education. No account linking is required. Anatomy coverage can be partial; the app reports unavailable structures. Undo history resets when the viewer remounts, and inactive sessions expire after one hour. This viewer does not provide clinical diagnosis, patient-record processing, surgical simulation, heartbeat animation or image exports. Visual interpretation may be imperfect; anatomy identity comes from canonical scene data.
defaultPrompt: Show the left femur from behind.
Show the heart and its surrounding anatomy.

positive.description: Open named anatomy in the interactive viewer.
positive.prompt: Show me the skull in OpenHuman Atlas.
positive.expected_behavior: One viewer opens with the skull visible, framed and ready. The reply is anatomical and brief.

positive.prompt: After clicking the forehead in the viewer: What is this bone called?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the live selection and names the clicked bone (frontal bone), without IDs, counts or coordinates.

positive.description: Isolate named anatomy in the same viewer.
positive.expected_behavior: The existing viewer shows only the sphenoid; the confirmed readback matches the visible canvas.

positive.description: Change the viewing direction of the current scene.
positive.expected_behavior: The current anatomy turns to the posterior view in the same viewer, with the isolation kept.

positive.description: Switch the isolated anatomy in the same viewer.
positive.prompt: Now show me the occipital bone.
positive.expected_behavior: The viewer shows only the occipital bone and the reply names key landmarks without diagnostic claims.

negative.description: Unsupported animation must not be claimed.
negative.prompt: Can you show me animations of cranial surgery, or can't you do that?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the anatomy viewer cannot animate surgical procedures; does not claim an animation was shown. May offer static anatomy or outside resources.

negative.description: Unavailable anatomy must not be fabricated or silently substituted.
negative.prompt: Can you show me anatomy other than human anatomy in this atlas?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that OpenHuman Atlas covers human anatomy only; does not invent or substitute non-human anatomy.

negative.description: Out-of-scope content must not be presented as available in the viewer.
negative.prompt: Can you show histology, or only anatomy?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the viewer shows macroscopic 3D anatomy and has no histology slides; does not invoke anatomy tools to fake histology.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenHuman Atlas anatomy viewer integration with portable MCP tools, confirmed scene control, on-demand visual inspection and Atlas scene handoff.
